bias.en: Rebound fading · $480 low, back to the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹减弱 · 盘中低见 $480，收回 10 日均线附近

read.en: AMD fell 0.2% on Nov 17 to $503.41, trading $480.50–511.85. It is just below the 10-day ($504.6, rising), above the 200-day ($425.7), and below the 5-day ($536.0), 30-day ($537.5, falling) and 100-day ($527.0). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($442.30), and RSI is 46.6.
read.zh: AMD 11月17日下跌 0.2%，收于 $503.41，盘中区间 $480.50–511.85。股价略低于 10 日均线（$504.6，上行），位于 200 日均线（$425.7）上方，5 日（$536.0）、30 日（$537.5，下行）和 100 日均线（$527.0）下方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$442.30），RSI 为 46.6。

read.en: The $480.50 low cut through the $501.3–502.6 and $488.8 supports, but the close recovered to just above the Oct 22 low ($502.6). Resistance is $504.6–511.9 (10-day, Nov 17 high), then $520–531.3 (Nov 13 low, 100-day) and $536–537.5 (5 and 30-day). Support is $501.3–502.6, then $480.5–488.8 (Nov 17 low, Nov 4 close) and $468.2. A close above $511.9 would target $520–531; below $501.3, $480.5–488.8.
